summary: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, targeting infrastructure and civilian areas. Air defenses reported intercepting numerous Shahed drones launched from multiple regions. Ukrainian forces struck an oil refinery in Omsk and a Nova Poshta logistics center in Kyiv. NATO Secretary General Rutte's comments suggest ongoing alliance discussions about Ukraine support.
key_points: Ukrainian forces struck the Omsk oil refinery, the largest in Russia, located over 2,500 km from the border, according to advisor Sergiy Sternenko (Source: @UkraineNow/82447).
Russian forces launched at least 54 Shahed drones from multiple regions including Primorsko-Akhmatarsk, Grozny, Millerovo, Oryol, occupied Donetsk, Bryansk, Shatalovo (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68626).
Three Ukrainian soldiers attempted to sell weapons worth 2 million hryvnias including 700 rounds of ammunition and four anti-tank weapons (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31430).
Kyiv and surrounding areas face increased ballistic missile threats due to air defense shortages, with potential for multiple simultaneous launches (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68622).
A Russian officer from GUR MOI and former security official were detained in Monaco over an assassination attempt on Yermolayev (Source: @tass_agency/384151).
Two civilians died in Sumy and Dnipropetrovsk regions from drone attacks, including a 35-year-old man and his son in Novoaidarka (Source: @tass_agency/384155).
Ukrainian Air Force warned Russia is preparing for new missile strikes possibly within 24 hours (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31423).

eastern_front: Russian forces continue small-arms battles in Bachevsk and Ulanovo areas of the Sumy direction with assault troops from the 'North' group (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31441).
Drone attacks hit Sumy and Dnipropetrovsk regions, causing two deaths and damaging infrastructure including a Nova Poshta facility in Luhansk region (Source: @UkraineNow/82458).
northern_front: Russian forces launched drones from Bryansk and occupied Donetsk regions targeting northern areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68626).
southern_front: Kherson region experienced complete or partial power outages following drone attacks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31441).
Belgorod region faced AFU strikes on infrastructure including gas pipeline facilities and Belgorod International Airport (Source: @eRadarrua/100033).
air_war: Ukrainian Air Force warned of imminent missile strikes, stating 'We don't have any missiles left to shoot down Russian ballistic missiles' (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31428).
Air defenses shot down 36 drones near Moscow and neutralized most of 430 drones launched at the Moscow region overnight (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31441).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are intensifying drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, with specific threats to Kyiv and infrastructure targets. Air defense capabilities are strained, with reports of missile shortages affecting interception capacity. Ukrainian forces are conducting long-range strikes into Russian territory, including critical infrastructure like oil refineries. The situation remains volatile with potential for further escalation.
sections.regional_response: NATO Secretary General Rutte's comments suggest ongoing alliance discussions about Ukraine support, though his reported 'stand-up routine' indicates potential diplomatic tensions. Ukrainian President Zelensky is focusing on domestic investigations into corruption and military misconduct. International attention is also on the detention of Ukrainian officials in Monaco related to an assassination attempt.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian military intelligence officer and former security official detained in Monaco over Yermolayev case suggest internal security concerns. Three soldiers attempting to sell military equipment indicates potential supply chain vulnerabilities. Air Force warnings about missile shortages highlight critical defense gaps requiring immediate attention.
